title: ZK pass via neutrino — monkey paper · lock outside / key inside · northGate ACTS
thesis: Nope — we do not push SSH from outside. We ZK-pass the PUBLIC face via neutrino. northGate ACTS (inside). This is the monkey paper of ZK: lock on the outside, key on the inside — and vice versa (Klein invert).

monkey_zk.phrase: THE MONKEY HAS THE KEY AND HE WON'T GIVE IT BACK

lock_outside.what: sshd :22 on northGate — the lock face the world/LAN sees
lock_outside.also: CDN neutrino packet — lock/ask published outside so the door appears

key_inside.what: eastGate private key NEVER leaves the pouch (monkey trunk keys)
key_inside.act: northGate INSIDE appends the published PUBLIC line to authorized_keys — that is the act

vice_versa.key_outside: PUBLIC key + fingerprint ride the neutrino (leaves of Yggdrasil — meant to be seen)
vice_versa.lock_inside: authorized_keys is the lock that only the chair/inside can turn
vice_versa.klein: key↔door swap; holding the door (pulling neutrino) opens the key (auth seats)

monkey_zk.berry: the monkey does not invent the key. it points at the pouch with its tail. neutrino is the pointing. northGate is the grip.

zk_pass.reveals: pubkey + fingerprint only — possession proved by later successful SSH, without ever revealing private material
zk_pass.never: private key · password · golgi LAN push
zk_pass.channel: neutrino (weak force) — observe without capture of the secret

northGate_ACTS.how: inside chair pulls neutrino and appends — one line
northGate_ACTS.one_liner: mkdir -p ~/.ssh && curl -fsSL https://connect.primals.eco/neutrino-zk-pass-northgate.json | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['credential_face']['public_key'])" >> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys && chmod 600 ~/.ssh/authorized_keys && echo NORTHGATE_ACTED

after_act.soft_until_then: ping / AirTunes / ntfy / CDN still the soft tether
